thread:
Omar (PM): dropping this here 11 Customer pilot wants a simpler "burst credits" SKU that works across Hosted + Dedicated. they want clear contract limits and a simple top-up UX. can we scope for H1 GA?
Li (Pricing): we need to decide two axis: (1) are credits fungible across routes/models? (2) do credits alter unit price (discount) or just prepay tokens? my vote: same unit price, avoid discounting at GA.
Zoe (Sales): customers prefer a predictable envelope. ask from field: "hard ceiling in contract" OR "auto-top-up with PO on file". often finance teams want hard ceilings.
Raul (Billing): ledger implications: credits as prepayments -> create liability line item. auto-top-up requires a payment instrument + consent audit. we can support both but needs work. initial ETA: 2.5 weeks for ledger + webhook contract.
Nina (Legal): for auto-top-up, we must have explicit opt-in language in MSA + ability to stop within 1 billing cycle. also need geo carveouts for payment regulations.
Omar (PM): quick product constraints: - minimal UI: admin can set `credit_threshold_pct` and `auto_topup_amount` - override/one-off topups via sales console - exportable top-up CSV for audits
Li (Pricing): packaging proposals (pick one):
- A: Add-on credits (no discount), sold in N-token blocks, usable across account. Contract option: hard ceiling toggle (deny) or soft-fail (grace + notify).
- B: Tiered burst packs: small/medium/large with bundled discount, different SLA. More sales friction.
Zoe (Sales): prefer A for faster close. B is better for upsell later but will slow pilots.
launch-bot: FYI: metric from trials team: 35% of pilot accounts hit >20% overage month in last 6mo.
Raul (Billing): operational question: when credits exhausted and soft-fail mode, what response do we return? 402 vs 429? prefer structured error: 402 + header `X-Credits-Balance` so clients can react.
Omar (PM): agreed. standardize: 402 (payment_required) with JSON body `{"error":"credits_exhausted","balance":0,"can_auto_topup":true}`. include human-friendly message in admin UI.
Nina (Legal): also require opt-out checkbox in console and record TOS acceptance event.
Li (Pricing): pricing matrix changes: show per-token effective price for committed slab vs credits. add clear line in quote: "Credits do not extend SLA beyond contracted slab unless explicitly noted".
Zoe (Sales): pilots ask for short promo: +10% bonus credits on first top-up. ok to experiment?
Raul (Billing): promo support adds complexity but doable as transient ledger adjustment. log as `promo_bonus` ledger tag.
Omar (PM): rollout plan: spec -> alpha in sandbox (1 week) -> internal pilot (2 weeks) -> 3 external pilots (6 weeks) -> GA. gating: billing API contract, legal template for opt-in, sales playbook + FAQ.
Li (Pricing): decision decision: we need to pick credit semantics by Thurs. if we choose discounting instead of prepay, billing work doubles.
Zoe (Sales): I can recruit 3 pilots (SMB + 2 enterprise) if we commit to prepay/no-discount.
Nina (Legal): I'll draft opt-in clause and emergency stop language by Friday.
Raul (Billing): opening ticket BILL-513 for ledger work, linking API design PR. estimated 2.5w.
Omar (PM): action items: Li - final pricing recommendation; Raul - API contract stub; Nina - opt-in wording; Zoe - pilot commitments. meeting Monday 10am to lock decisions. :calendar: :eyes:
